SEEKER knows their own goal: find a funny comedy similar to *She’s Out of My League*. They know which suggested movies they have seen, liked, disliked, or not seen, and they know the recommender is trying to find something they have not seen. After the recommender’s “ok, ummm,” SEEKER knows the recommender is pausing/stalling and has not offered a new movie to react to.

SEEKER does **not** know what movie the recommender will suggest next, whether the recommender has more candidates in mind, or why the recommender paused beyond the visible “ok, ummm.” SEEKER also does not know the evaluation choices.

Since there is no new recommendation to give feedback on, and the recommender is stuck, SEEKER is most likely to help by adding more preference information, such as actors, genres, or past favorites.
